book.title: Baluwa jhubhele jha Pauli kwa Akatecholonike

content: Mutujhope kwa Chapanga
Pukujhomolela, makalongo bhito, mutujhope kupala lilobhe lya Bhambo lichoche kujhenela kajhombe na kupokelwa mbone ngita chiibhii pakate jhino mangota.
Mutujhope kwa Chapanga atukombole kuhumii kwa bhando bhanganandela, nhwalo chi bhoha bhubhajhekete Lilobhe lya Mbone lende.
Nambo Bhambo ndi jwa jwahobholeka. Jwenio nambela makakala na kunnonda njelembo na Jwanganandela.
Na twenga tunhobholela Bhambo kubhehe nhenga na nnyendelela kuhenga kwa ghala ghitunnongalile.
Bhambo ailongoche miojho jhino mukumanya upalo nkolongwa gwa Chapanga na kuhimbilila ghutupilwe na Kilichitu.
Mipalwa kuhenga lihengo
Makalongo bhito, tunnaghalikiya kwa liina lya Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu, ntame kutale na akalongo bhoha akatotoho na bhala bhubhakana kukengama malaghilo ghitumpekiye.
Mangota umanye ngita mipalwa kukengama ghituhengita. Putukibha na mangota tukibha jhe akatotoho,
tukalii jhe jhajhe chakulya cha mundo jhojhoha. Nambo tuhengita mahengo hake muhe na kilo kwa malagho tukoto kubhehe nhwigho kwa mundo jhojhoha pakate jhino mangota.
Tuhengita gheniya chi kwa nhwalo tupaii jhe kutangatilwa na mangota, nambo tupalitwa kunangii chimipalwa kuhenga.
Putukibha pamonga na mangota tukannongolile, “Mundo jhojhoha jwangapala kuhenga lihengo, akoto kulyegha.”
Tujhoha pakate jhino bhabhii bhando akatotoho bhangapala kuhenga chochoha, nambo bhakijhingii mu ilebhe ya bhando bhange.
Kwa liina lya Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu twalaghalikiya na kwakelebhuha bhando bheniya bhabha akahenga lihengo kwa kukilongocha bhene na bhapata chakulya chabhe.
Nambo mangota makalongo, nkoto kutotokelela kuhenga ghambone.
Anda abhii mundo kwino jwangajhokanikiya lilobhe lende lya mubaluwa jhenje, mwangalombana nako mundo jwenio akola hone.
Nambo nkoto kuntenda mundo jwenio ngita likoko, munkelebhuwe ngita nnongo gwino.
Malobhe gha kujhomolela
Bhambo jwenio ndi jwapiya uteeke, ampelangane uteeke machiko ghoha na ndela yoha. Bhambo atame na mangota mabhoha.
Nenga Pauli, ninyambucha kwa kunnyandikila kwa lubhoko lwango namwete. Jhenje ndi huna mu kila baluwa, naha ndi chinijhandika.
Umbone gwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu utama na mangota mabhoha.
